1. TS-OT-CONSTRAINED-001 — Compromise of a SICAM 8 RTU through the maintenance network
The attacker controls the maintenance laptop or uses compromised credentials. Through the established path, the attacker reaches the RUGGEDCOM RST2428P.
CVE-2024-38597 affects RUGGEDCOM RST2428P when the deployed version is earlier than V3.1. If the deployed firmware version is earlier than V3.1, the attacker can exploit the input-validation vulnerability. The scenario assumes that the preceding step succeeds, allowing the SICAM 8 CPCI85 to become accessible.
CVE-2024-31485 affects SICAM 8 CPCI85 when the deployed version is earlier than V5.30. If the deployed firmware version is earlier than V5.30 and the attacker has authenticated privileged access to the device's web interface, the attacker can exploit the command-injection vulnerability to execute arbitrary code with root privileges.
The attacker may impair an operational control or communication function.
